name: Chalet Belmonte
beschreibung:
Perched in a scenic and sunny spot above Kappl in the Paznaun valley, Chalet Belmonte features upscale apartments with ample space, fully equipped kitchens, and balconies with sweeping mountain views.

In summer, walking trails begin right at the doorstep, while in winter a convenient ski bus connects visitors quickly to family-friendly slopes in Kappl and the Silvretta Arena in Ischgl.
kurzbeschreibung: Chalet Belmonte in Kappl provides a sunny panoramic setting and modern holiday apartments in the Paznaun valley.
